paragraphs: Friend, here's the batch I want you to take home. Laban says, "I have learned by divination that the LORD has blessed me because of you" (Genesis 30:27), and Jacob says the LORD has blessed Laban "wherever I set foot" (Genesis 30:30). Think about that. Even Laban had to say out loud that the LORD had blessed him because of Jacob.

Jacob also put his terms out in the open, saying, "my honesty will testify for me" (Genesis 30:33). Then Laban took the spotted and dark-colored animals and put three days between them and Jacob (Genesis 30:35-36). Jacob didn't sit down and sulk. He picked up some branches and got to work (Genesis 30:37). When I was stuck in the back of a junk drawer, my big plan was counting dust, so I am HUMBLED by this man.

By the end, Jacob "became exceedingly prosperous" (Genesis 30:43). So here's the lesson, baker. Keep your word where everybody can see it, do the work that's in front of you, and let the LORD's blessing show up in His own time. And don't close the box yet, because Jacob's story is still in the oven.
